data.body: **[P2] Preserve the resolved trace state in Workflow placeholders.** The sampling result intentionally retains `TraceState` from a same-trace ambient span, whereas `execution_ancestor.trace_state` is normally empty. Consequently this placeholder differs from the terminal recording Workflow span; auto-instrumented children lose vendor tracestate, and the identical construction in `InvocationOtelPlugin` produces links with the wrong context. In both plugins, use `_sampling_intent.result.trace_state` when present, falling back to the ancestor state, and cover the pre-terminal placeholder with a same-trace ambient tracestate test.
